metadata.scenario: A member decides to cancel their membership and requests to know the next steps. Category: Cancellation. Flags: cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, it's Lucille Davis. I wanted to discuss my membership. Hi Lucille! I hope you're doing well. What would you like to discuss about your membership? Well, I've been thinking about cancelling my personal care assistance services. I understand. May I ask what’s leading you to that decision? Honestly, I’m feeling a bit better with my arthritis, and I’m considering managing on my own. But it's a tough decision. That makes sense, Lucille. It's great to hear you're feeling better! Thank you! But I'm still unsure if I should completely cancel, just want to know my options. Absolutely, I can help with that. If you decide to cancel, we can walk through the next steps together. Okay, what do I need to do to proceed with cancelling? First, I’ll need to gather some information from you to finalize the cancellation. Alright, what do you need? I’ll need your confirmation in writing, either via email or a physical letter. I can send an email. What’s the address? You can email me directly at info@carefirsthomehealth.com. Got it. Anything else? Also, please let us know if you would like to schedule any final visits while you transition. I might need a couple more visits for assistance with my exercises. That’s perfectly fine! We can arrange for a few additional sessions. How much would those additional visits cost? Our personal care assistance is priced at $28-$35 per hour. Would you like to schedule those now? Yes, I think I’d like to schedule two more visits for next week. Perfect! I can set those up for you. Would you prefer morning or afternoon? Mornings would be best. Great, I’ll schedule those for you. Just to confirm, that’ll be two morning visits next week. Yes, that sounds good. I’ll also note your cancellation request in our system. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You're welcome, Lucille! If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Will do. I appreciate your support. It’s my pleasure! Have a great day, Lucille. You too, bye. Bye!
